# Command Regulations
These are non-modifiable SOP's that cannot be changed unless approved by a member of Provost.
## Briefing and Memorial Conduct The Commander is to ensure a proper briefing is held before any personnel are deployed. As well as a memorial for any fallen troops after a operation has concluded. - Briefings should at minimum, have all Squad Leaders present and all CIC related Staff. - Briefing must be held in a area where it does not distupt department activity and within a area large enough where inspection of personnel can be carried out. - Intelligence Officer, Scouts and assigned specialised squads may deploy before the main briefing for scouting so long as they have been informed of their orders and tasks. - Any personnel that would not normally be able to deploy past the FOB cannot be deployed early for scouting. - Memorials may be held imediately after a operation or held at a later date with attendance being optional.
## Areas ### Forward Operating base The Commander must take minimum precautions to ensure the saftey of stationed personnel and transport of troops by selecting a Forward Operating Base. - The FOB must be a secured area designated by the Commander around the primary LZ or entrance to military site. - Once a primary landing zone has been selected it cannot be modified or changed. - The FOB at minimum requires a line on non-makeshift barricades and stationed personnel. - Only Bravo may be used to station in defense of the FOB and surrounding area.
## Law Enforcement UCMJ must be followed at all times, members of command have access to the Brig as well as it's vendors any may carry military police equipment and assume the role of military police at any time. - Members of Command cannot ignore crimes just like any other member of the military police. - Only the CMP may designate non members of command to carry military police equipment and carry out military police law.
## Command Arms Command must abide by the following regulations regarding arming themselves on the ship or in the field: - Command may not take any type of special weaponry, equipment or armor from Requsitions or Racks, and may only use standard issue arms found in their respective armoury, or rifleman prep. - Command Staff are allowed to operate special weapons only if no one else in the vicinity is doing so and there is an emergency going on.
